text:
maria: heads-up — onboarding test for aurora20b packed-int4v3 shows quality wobble after a long prefill, looks like a KV packing boundary issue but could be RoPE phase aliasing.

samuel: which boundary this time? different from the 64k reports?

maria: yep, this one hits at token 131072 (we use a 128k slice for this dataset). divergence starts exactly there, not earlier. small repro attached.

maria: repro:```bash
./bench/prefill_runner --model aurora20b --quant packed-int4v3 --prompt longbook.txt --max-tokens 140000 --dump-kv-checksums --rope-scale 1.0
```

bench-bot: job queued: job=bb-5312468000, runner=canary-12, est=48m

kai: can you paste the checksum diff around the split?

maria: checksum lines:```KV_CHECK 0x1ffe0: crc=0x4a5b
KV_CHECK 0x1ffe1: crc=0x4a5b
KV_CHECK 0x20000: crc=0x91c3 <-- flips here for int4v3
KV_CHECK 0x20001: crc=0x91c3
# fp16 baseline keeps 0x4a5b across these offsets
```

samuel: flipping at 0x20000 (131072) — looks like a tile boundary where quant packer changes its lane layout. packed-int4v3 introduced a new interleave where 512-byte macrotiles are split into 64-byte microtiles. maybe an off-by-one in tile_count calc.

priya: action items: get a pure roundtrip test (no model compute) that writes sequential KV pages, then reads back and compares. if it fails then kernel. also test with rope_scale=0.5 and rope_scale=2.0 to see if RoPE scaling masks it.

maria: ran roundtrip:```./tools/kv_roundtrip --size 140000 --quant packed-int4v3 --verify --tile-size 512```

triage-bot: queued triage ticket RI-20260301-17, severity=medium, owner=unassigned

maria: roundtrip fails at page 0x20000 with a repeating 2-bit error pattern every 512 bytes. hexdump:```offset 0x20000: expected aa bb cc dd, found aa ba cc dd```

kai: 2-bit flip repeated every 512 bytes suggests a mis-applied byte lane XOR or stale temporary buffer reused across macrotiles. packed-int4v3's shuffle stage uses an 8x64 buffer — maybe the buffer index resets incorrectly at macro boundaries.

samuel: does fp16 or int8 show this?
maria: fp16 and our legacy int4 show clean roundtrip. only packed-int4v3.

kai: ok I'll instrument the packer with guard writes and run under asan on CPU to catch any out-of-bounds. also add a small reproducer that toggles tile-size between 256/512/1024 to see sensitivity.

priya: longer-term: add an eval to our onboarding job that includes checkpoints at tile boundaries (e.g., 63.9k, 64k, 64.1k, 128k, 128.1k) for every new quant kernel. prevents regressions on odd window sizes.

maria: on perf: packed-int4v3 gives ~1.9x speed up vs int8 for full-run, but quality (perplexity) delta at 140k is +0.6 vs fp16. unacceptable for long-prefill customers.

samuel: mitigation: gate packed-int4v3 behind a runtime flag and default long-prefill routes to int8 until fix. also notify customers on beta who requested 128k+ contexts.

kai: digging in now. initial suspicion: buffer_index = (tile_idx % num_buffers) uses num_buffers derived from tile_size/64 — off-by-one when tile_size == 512 yields num_buffers=8 and index calc wraps incorrectly on exact multiple. adding unit test now.

maria: thanks. I put a quick smoke patch to force int8 for canary-12 to avoid noisy alerts. rolling that out.

bench-bot: job bb-5312468000 completed (failed), logs at s3://bench-logs/5312468000.log

priya: once kai has a candidate fix, please run the long-goldset regression (the one with legal-docs longbook) and compare token-level entropy around the boundary. include a diff tool to highlight repeated tokens.

maria: will do. adding logs and CRC dumps to the ticket.

kai: creating PR: fix/pack-int4v3-macrotiling-index, adding unit + kv_roundtrip CI. will post link when ready.

maria: appreciated. tagging this into the onboarding board under "quant-kernel instability". :white_check_mark:
